notes.title: Game Update #3
notes.content: [h3]Fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Aura passive of the defense tower "Bastion" was not taking effect.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New challenges and maze sharing
notes.content: [h2][b]Challenge Gameplay and Leaderboard[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Introduction[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The newly added challenge gameplay features several high-difficulty levels, where you only need to defend for one day.[/p][/*][*][p]Select a maze from your save files to start the defense battle.[/p][/*][*][p]After the defense ends, battle data will be calculated to determine your score. The following metrics will affect the score:[/p][list][*][p]The age of the maze.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of monsters killed.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of waypoints passed by monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Total health of escaped monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Duration of the battle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Your score will be automatically uploaded to the leaderboard. If it’s your best score, the information of the maze you’re currently using will also be attached to the leaderboard to share with other players (Note: This operation will not proceed if you are not connected to the internet).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay Restrictions[/b][/h3][p]Your save file must clear the regular levels (defeat the Blue Dragon) to participate in the challenge gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Updates and Optimizations[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Optimized the playback frequency of battle sound effects.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update #2
notes.content: [h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A passive ability that triggers when a monster is killed by friendly damage was incorrectly targeting towers, leading to towers being destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The type restriction for the purification effect of aqua-element skill was not taking effect.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When creating a new game, game names containing abnormal characters could cause save files to fail to read correctly.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A crash issue that could occur when a large number of bouncing projectiles attack a large number of monsters.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The tower "Tsunami" had an incorrect range that far exceeded the normal value, which has now been adjusted back.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced the frequency of effects triggered by the interaction between spark and aqua elements, while increasing the damage they deal. Overall damage has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Add Save Management.[/p][list][*][p][b]Rename[/b]: Modify the display name of save files in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Copy Path[/b]: Copy the save file path to the system clipboard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Create Copy[/b]: Generate a duplicate of the save file.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content: [p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a time zone problem caused a black screen on startup.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the attack speed value provided by the aura of the high - level Wind Tower.[/p][/*][/list]
